role: SwiftFormat configuration used by `make format` (Makefile, write mode over Emuqu and EmuquTests) and by .githooks/pre-commit:82-97 (advisory --lint on the staged .swift files; a non-zero exit prints a note and does not block the commit). No CI gate or workflow runs it.
toplevel: Options: --swiftversion 6.0 (comment: the language mode every target compiles in, SWIFT_VERSION in project.pbxproj), --indent 4, --linebreaks lf, --elseposition same-line, --exclude .build,build,DerivedData,Emuqu.xcodeproj, --trailing-commas never (yields to SwiftLint trailing_comma so the two tools do not fight over ~745 commas and the .ci/swiftlint_warning_budget.txt). Options for the disabled wrapArguments, trailingSpace and fileHeader rules are left out, as the header says. The last line disables 40 rules (docComments, redundantSwiftUIGroup, wrap*Bodies, indent, redundantSelf, redundantReturn, conditionalAssignment, hoistPatternLet, redundantClosure, redundantType, preferKeyPath, andOperator, redundantViewBuilder, fileHeader, numberFormatting, sortSwitchCases, modifierOrder, noForceUnwrapInTests, wrapArguments, wrapMultilineStatementBraces, consecutiveSpaces, blankLines*, trailingSpace, spaceAroundOperators, unusedArguments, hoistTry, hoistAwait, docCommentsBeforeModifiers, redundantVariable, redundantThrows, redundantOptionalBinding, redundantFileprivate) with per-rule reasons in comments. Header records that neither tool had ever run and the pre-commit hook was a no-op before being wired, and says the disabled rules remove the worst churn but the tree still does not conform (see .githooks/pre-commit), so `make format` still rewrites many files and should be run as a change of its own. `make format` (Makefile) only formats `Emuqu EmuquTests`, so the watch-app Swift files are never formatted by it. No runtime effect on the app.
